newsitem.title: USA: Japanese girl awaiting new heart dies.
newsitem.headline: Japanese girl awaiting new heart dies.

text.p: An eight-year-old Japanese girl awaiting a heart transplant at a Los Angeles hospital died early Tuesday morning, officials said.

Miyuki Monobe arrived at the University of California Los Angeles Medical Centre on March 29 hoping for a new heart, but she died without a suitable donor organ being found, a hospital spokeswoman said.
The girl suffered a heart attack on April 3 and hospital spokeswoman Ruthie Marek said at the time she was "very, very sick," and in critical condition.
She was placed on a heart-lung machine and remained on it until her death.

Monobe, who was born with a hole in her heart, came to the United States from her home in Shinagawa, Japan, looking for a new heart. Such transplants are very rare in Japan because of that country's organ donor laws.
Doctors at the hospital declared her a suitable heart transplant recipient, and she was placed on the United Network for Organ Sharing transplant list.
